project_context.name: Smart Office Inventory Rental & Warehouse System
project_context.design_direction: Minimal, modern, clean, fast. Airbnb + Google Calendar feel. Search-first. Simplicity over features.
project_context.flow: BOOK -> APPROVE -> ACCESS -> TAKE -> USE -> RETURN

typography.instruction_to_main_agent: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all headings. Never use Inter for headings. Ensure high contrast against the dark background. DO NOT center align text globally.

colors.instruction_to_main_agent: Use the exact status colors above for badges and indicators. Do not use generic Vercel/Stripe palettes. Never use pure transparent background on dropdowns or headers over content.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Mobile-first focus.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Use p-6 or p-8 for containers and cards.
spacing_and_layout.grids: High Density Grid for Dashboards (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6. Grid children MUST be direct children.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Bento layout for dashboard summary, high-density grids for item lists.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-full for buttons.

components.buttons: Large touch targets (min-h-12 or min-h-14). Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use brand color. High contrast hover states.
components.cards: Subtle 1px border (border-white/10), flat background (bg-zinc-900), no deep shadow. On hover: -translate-y-1, border-white/20.
components.forms: Minimal forms. Use Shadcn components heavily customized (Inputs, Select, Dialog). Never use native inputs.
components.status_badges: Color-coded pills based on status. Add glowing effect for AVAILABLE items.
components.navigation: Sticky bottom nav on mobile, top glassmorphism nav on desktop (backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/60).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Glassmorphism for sticky headers/modals: backdrop-blur-xl bg-zinc-950/60 border-b border-white/10. NO fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle noise/grain effect or CSS grid background to break the flat digital look.
visual_enhancers.motion: Hover states on all interactive elements. Page transitions using Framer Motion.

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Ensure 4.5:1 for normal text. Text shadow when placed over images.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.instruction_to_main_agent: Use these EXACT URLs for inventory items and background assets. DO NOT use generic placeholder text or dummy image URLs. Ensure images have a max height (max-h-[80vh]) on mobile and use bg-black/50 overlay if placing text over them.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: DO NOT output generic 'AI slop' frontend design. Break patterns! Think Airbnb for smart warehouses.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Apply transitions to specific properties like transform and opacity.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & context-relevant colors.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
MANDATORY: Add 'data-testid' to every interactive or important element (e.g., data-testid='search-inventory-input').
MANDATORY: Indonesian language for all UI text (e.g., 'Cari Barang', 'Pinjam', 'Kembalikan').
DO NOT build HTML-based components for advanced interactions like dropdowns, calendars, or toasts. Use Shadcn components instead.

principles: Simplicity over features: Hide unnecessary details until needed.
Clear Status: Status badges (AVAILABLE, BOOKED, BORROWED, OVERDUE) must be instantly recognizable.
Search-first interface: The main landing page should feature a prominent search bar.
Mobile-first: Large touch targets, bottom sheets for forms, and sticky CTAs.
